tickerText: [TENNIS] US Open Day 1 Aug 30 — Djokovic opens vs Navone, Pegula vs Ruse on Ashe; Venus Williams faces Kenin in wild-card night session at Flushing Meadows • [SQUASH] World Squash Masters underway in Perth — 900+ players across 21 age groups; Alex Preston claims first win on Karrinyup all-glass court • [BADMINTON] Lee Zii Jia targets Vietnam Open reset Sept 8 after Korean Masters exit — Malaysia star skipping Asian Games to rebuild form • [PICKLEBALL] MLP Championship Sunday at Wollman Rink — NJ 5s vs St. Louis Shock on CBS at noon ET in best-of-three title series • [TABLE TENNIS] ETTU Champions League Stage 1 finale in Lille — final group matches today decide eight clubs advancing to Stage 2

newsItems.title: World Squash Masters Opens in Perth
newsItems.excerpt: The 2026 World Squash Masters Championships kicked off Sunday with 900+ players across 21 age categories — England's Alex Preston claimed the first win on the all-glass show court at Karrinyup Shopping Centre.

newsItems.title: MLP Title Sunday in Central Park
newsItems.excerpt: New Jersey 5s and St. Louis Shock meet in the DoorDash MLP Finals best-of-three at Wollman Rink — Championship Sunday airs on CBS at noon ET with Tennis Channel coverage from 2 p.m.

newsItems.title: Zii Jia Eyes Vietnam Open Reset
newsItems.excerpt: Malaysia's Lee Zii Jia will use the Sept 8–13 Vietnam Open to regroup after a Korean Masters first-round exit and skipping the Asian Games, chasing his first title since the 2024 Australian Open.

newsItems.title: ETTU Stage 1 Wraps in Lille
newsItems.excerpt: The HYLO ETTU Champions League men's Stage 1 concludes Sunday in Lille — top two clubs in each of four groups secure berths in Stage 2, joining eight seeded sides in the Round of 16.
